The document is the summary for the interface signal for reference when building the Wishbone. 

# Wishbone Master and Slave Implementation

**Source References:**
- https://wishbone-interconnect.readthedocs.io/en/latest/01_introduction.html
---

## 1. Summary

* **Master Interface:** is an IP core interface capable of initiating data transfer cycles. Every WISHBONE-based system must include at least one MASTER interface.
* **Slave Interface:** is an IP core interface capable of receiving and responding to transfer cycles generated by a MASTER. Every WISHBONE-based system must include at least one SLAVE interface.

---

## 2. Signal Definitions Table

### Master Interface Signals

| Signal Name | Direction | Label / Name | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `CLK_I` | Input | Clock Input | Master clock input for synchronous timing operation. |
| `RST_I` | Input | Reset Input | System reset input. |
| `DAT_I()` | Input | Data Input Array | Input data array from the Slave. |
| `ACK_I` | Input | Acknowledge Input | Indicates normal termination of a bus cycle by the Slave. |
| `ERR_I` | Input | Error Input | Indicates an abnormal termination of a bus cycle. |
| `RTY_I` | Input | Retry Input | Indicates the target Slave is busy; request should be retried. |
| `ADR_O()` | Output | Address Output | Output address bus specifying the target register or memory location. |
| `DAT_O()` | Output | Data Output Array | Output data array sent to the Slave. |
| `CYC_O` | Output | Bus Cycle Valid | Asserted for the entire duration of a valid bus transaction. |
| `STB_O` | Output | Strobe Output | Indicates a valid data transfer cycle; qualifies active signals. |
| `WE_O` | Output | Write Enable | Asserted (`1`) for WRITE transactions; negated (`0`) for READ. |
| `SEL_O()` | Output | Select Output Array | Selects active byte lanes on the data bus. |

---

### Slave Interface Signals

| Signal Name | Direction | Label / Name | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `CLK_I` | Input | Clock Input | Master clock input for synchronous timing operation. |
| `RST_I` | Input | Reset Input | System reset input. |
| `ADR_I()` | Input | Address Input | Input address array driven by the Master. |
| `DAT_I()` | Input | Data Input Array | Input data array driven by the Master during a WRITE cycle. |
| `CYC_I` | Input | Bus Cycle Valid | High when a valid bus cycle is active. |
| `STB_I` | Input | Strobe Input | High when this specific Slave is addressed for transfer. |
| `WE_I` | Input | Write Enable | High for WRITE cycle; Low for READ cycle. |
| `SEL_I()` | Input | Select Input Array | Indicates active byte lanes driven by Master. |
| `DAT_O()` | Output | Data Output Array | Output data driven back to Master during READ cycles. |
| `ACK_O` | Output | Acknowledge Output | Asserted to indicate successful completion of cycle request. |
| `ERR_O` | Output | Error Output | Optional output asserted to report transfer error. |
| `RTY_O` | Output | Retry Output | Optional output asserted to request a transfer retry. |

---
